scripts.desktop:build: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run tauri --workspace @mistake-agent/desktop -- build --no-bundle
scripts.desktop:build:debug: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run tauri --workspace @mistake-agent/desktop -- build --debug --no-bundle
scripts.test:workflow-pdf: npm run typecheck --workspace @mistake-agent/desktop && cd .. && node --test tests/test_workflow_pdf.mjs tests/test_workflow_pdf_export.mjs
scripts.test:workflow-storage: npm run typecheck --workspace @mistake-agent/desktop && cd .. && cargo build --quiet --manifest-path tools/storage-check/Cargo.toml --bin workflow_store_probe && node --test tests/test_workflow_persistence.mjs tests/test_workflow_persistent_pdf.mjs
scripts.test:workflow-desktop-export: npm run typecheck --workspace @mistake-agent/desktop && cd .. && cargo build --locked --manifest-path tools/storage-check/Cargo.toml --bin workflow_store_probe --bin workflow_export_probe && node --test tests/test_workflow_desktop_export.mjs
